purpose: Digests a caller-supplied UTF-8 string or hex byte string with SHA-256, or computes HMAC-SHA256 over it under a caller-supplied hex key, and echoes the algorithm id. It exists to give the shared guest-safe SHA-256 bundle a live execution surface: the kernel carries the bundle verbatim, so its fixtures, property floor and execution_hash exercise the exact bytes other kernels will later inline. Input is bounded at 64 KiB; anything else (unknown mode, unknown encoding, non-string or non-hex input, missing or non-hex key, oversize input) is rejected with a closed reason code and no digest. The kernel makes no policy decision and is not a signature scheme: HMAC here is a keyed digest over data the caller supplies, and the key travels in the request.
